positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Independent Web Developer, Applications Consultant.
positions.description: I worked with a variety of clients to develop original, consumer-focused websites and to modernize existing sites with social and brand-endearing features. All projects used agile development concepts of use-case driven development, rapid iteration, tested deployments, and regular progress and budget reviews. Every platform offered customer-controlled content with custom CMS interfaces and CRM software integration. All sites were developed and tested to be cross-platform and full-featured, using HTML5 and JavaScript, degrading elegantly when needed, and functional across  traditional and mobile platforms.

positions.title: IT Support Specialist, Web Developer, Applications Consultant.
positions.description: My position began as an independent web developer, contracted to expand a legacy web-based employee management system. I was later hired on to oversee IT operations for 17 dental offices in Florida, which expanded to include remote support for any of the company's offices across the eastern US. With the merger of my original employer, Consolident, Inc., into Great Expressions, I performed the IT-related aspects of the lengthy merger: inventory and asset tracking; inter-company education; and integration of the old and new business software. After the merger, my responsibilities grew to include Active Directory administration, database integration for our proprietary applications team, and web application development for corporate websites.

positions.title: Independent Web Developer, IT Support Specialist, Audio Technician
positions.description: Designed and developed a variety of websites ranging from personal blogs, retail e-commerce sites, print-to-web design conversions, and podcasting sites and feeds. The breadth and variety of projects allowed me to establish and diversify my skill set, while honing my core competencies in web development, systems administration, and customer relations.

positions.title: Network Administration Student Assistant
positions.description: I worked for the University's Network Administration department in a variety of roles including end-user support through trouble-ticket management and phone support; collaborating with field technicians to diagnose problems and reconfigure networking hardware locally and remotely; and inventory tracking and visualization by locating and cataloging our hardware assets. Beyond the normal scope of a student assistant, I created custom UNIX applications that integrated with our enterprise network management software to address critical department tasks such as tracking network use-policy violators.
